<summary>Background command "cd ~/Sites/sim-neural-memory && sed -i '' 's/    w_rf_nS: float = 4.0 /    w_rf_nS: float = 0.6 /; s/    w_fe_nS: float = 1.0 /    w_fe_nS: float = 0.3 /' src/neurotape/habituation/config.py && grep -n "w_rf_nS\|w_fe_nS" src/neurotape/habituation/config.py && S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-joshuaanderton-Sites-audio-projects-projects-neurotape/6c2338eb-6a94-402a-acd5-bf959cb12846/scratchpad && cat > $S/eta_b.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, time
from neurotape.habituation.config import load, HabConfig
from neurotape.habituation.protocol import make_sim
from neurotape.habituation.stimuli import family
base = load("configs/habituation.yaml").model_dump()
for eta in (0.002, 0.005, 0.01):
    res=[]
    for seed in (901,902):
        d=dict(base); d["seed"]=seed; d["ffinh"]=dict(on=True, plastic=True, eta=eta)
        c=HabConfig.model_validate(d); sim, st = make_sim(c)
        fam=family(seed,1.5,1,[]); rng=np.random.default_rng(4)
        G0=st.G.copy(); t=time.time(); R=[]
        for k in range(20):
            rec=sim.present(st, fam.stored, rng); R.append(rec.e_count.sum()); sim.quiet(st,1.5,rng)
        conn=sim.net.W_fe>0; dG=(st.G[0]-G0[0])[conn]
        top=np.sort(st.G[0][conn])[-int(0.1*conn.sum()):]
        # silence drift: 60 s direct
        g1=st.G.copy(); sim.quiet(st,60,rng); drift=(st.G-g1)[0][conn]
        res.append((top.mean(), np.percentile(st.G[0][conn],50), dG.min(), R[0], R[-1], drift.mean(), time.time()-t))
    print(eta, np.round(np.mean(res,0),4))
EOF
.venv/bin/python $S/eta_b.py 2>&1 | grep -v -i warn" completed (exit code 0)</summary>

import numpy as np
from neurotape.habituation.config import load, HabConfig
from neurotape.habituation.protocol import make_sim
base = load("configs/habituation.yaml").model_dump()
for dep in (False, True):
    d=dict(base); d["seed"]=901; d["depression"]={"on":dep}; d["receptor"]=dict(on=True, k_int=0.02)
    c=HabConfig.model_validate(d); sim, st = make_sim(c)
    n=st.copy(); sim.quiet(n,300,np.random.default_rng(1))
    st.Srec[:]=0.7; st.Irec[:]=0.3
    a=st.copy(); sim.quiet(a,120,np.random.default_rng(7)); b=st.copy(); sim.fast_forward(b,120)
    print("dep",dep,"naive S after 300 s", n.Srec.mean().round(4), "| S direct", a.Srec.mean().round(4), "ff", b.Srec.mean().round(4), " I", a.Irec.mean().round(4), b.Irec.mean().round(4))
EOF" completed (exit code 0)</summary>
